mapper.select: SELECT names.display_name, HEX(WEIGHT_STRING( CAST(names.display_name AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci )) AS match_key FROM JSON_TABLE( #{displayNamesJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(display_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$') ) AS names ORDER BY names.display_name

SELECT id, display_name, HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(display_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci)) AS match_key FROM t_auth_user WHERE is_active=1 AND HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(display_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci)) IN #{matchKey} ORDER BY match_key,id LIMIT #{candidateLimit} FOR UPDATE
